svg.text: Broadcom software paths across the VCF fleet
The Software Depot requests external content through the customer proxy and makes it available to VCF consumers.
Grey arrows: outbound requests · Teal: software and OVF content · Purple: OCI artifacts · Dashed: optional path
OCI registry interface serves registry content
Proxy configured per VCF services runtime
Separate host; configure its own network access and proxy
and pushes them to a Harbor project
1 PAIS mirrored to an optional Harbor requires the external PAIS YAML definition; AMT generates the installation and service configuration YAML files.
Connected mode above; manual flows are separate workflows. VCF Download Tool uploads and PAIS AMT mirroring have distinct purposes.
Optional Harbor content, supported use and trust depend on the workflow. Management arrows do not prove an instance-level staging sequence.
Sources: VCF 9.1.x pp. 2442–2443, 3973–3979, 4498–4503; Private AI Foundation 9.1 pp. 99–113.
